name: Fondukistan central sanctuary
scope: Whole central sanctuary structure only: complete square court and surrounding twelve vaulted niches, south entrance and central stupa as a bounded historical architectural reconstruction. Unlocated monastery cells, meeting hall and common rooms remain separate unresolved bodies; this member does not complete the monastery.
